scalars.name: Supercharger Boost Reduce IAT
scalars.note: If IAT is above this value then IAT Max Boost is used.

scalars.name: Supercharger Full Boost Enable IAT
scalars.note: If active, IAT must fall below this value to disable the IAT Max Boost limit.

scalars.name: Supercharger IAT Max Boost %
scalars.note: Maximum Boost % when IAT thresholds are exceeded.

scalars.name: Supercharger Boost Reduce ECT
scalars.note: If ECT is below this value then ECT Max Boost is used.

scalars.name: Supercharger Full Boost Enable ECT
scalars.note: If active, ECT must move above this value to disable the ECT Max Boost limit.

scalars.name: Supercharger ECT Max Boost %
scalars.note: Maximum Boost % when ECT thresholds are met.

scalars.name: Supercharger Cam Min Angle
scalars.note: Minimum camshaft angle for Cam Phaser boost limit.

scalars.name: Supercharger Cam Min TPS
scalars.note: Minimum throttle for Cam Phaser boost limit.

scalars.name: Supercharger Cam Max Boost %
scalars.note: Maximum Boost % for Cam Phaser boost limit.

scalars.name: Supercharger COT Max Boost %
scalars.note: Maximum Boost % when COT EQ threshold is exceeded.

scalars.name: Supercharger MAP Disable
scalars.note: Above this MAP boost control will be disbaled.

scalars.name: Supercharger MAP Enable
scalars.note: MAP must be below this to enable boost control.

scalars.name: Supercharger Boost Disable VSS Min
scalars.note: If VSS is greater than VSS Min and TPS is less than TPS Max then boost will be disabled.

scalars.name: Supercharger Boost Disable TPS Max
scalars.note: If VSS is greater than VSS Min and TPS is less than TPS Max then boost will be disabled.

scalars.name: Supercharger Boost Ramp
scalars.note: Boost will ramp in at this rate when re-enabled, lower numbers mean slower ramp in.

scalars.name: Supercharger Boost Int Gain
scalars.note: Integral gain for boost control.

scalars.name: Supercharger Max Torque Gear VSS
scalars.note: Minimum vehicle speed to enable Supercharger Max Torque Gear table.

scalars.name: Supercharger Max Torque Gear Delay
scalars.note: Time that Gear and VSS limits must be met to enbale Supercharger Gear Torque Mult table.

scalars.name: Number Of Cylinders
scalars.note: Number of cylinders in the engine.

scalars.name: Cylinder Volume
scalars.note: The volume (displacement) of one cylinder.

scalars.name: Tach Output Resolutions - High
scalars.note: Number of periods the tach output remains high.

scalars.name: Tach Output Resolutions - Low
scalars.note: Number of periods the tach output remains low.

scalars.name: Idle Underspeed Throttle Closed Delay
scalars.note: Adaptive idle may enable after throttle is closed for this amount of time during idle underspeed.

scalars.name: Min RPM Reference
scalars.note: Minimum allowed current RPM reference in idle mode.

scalars.name: Idle Adaptive Max VSS
scalars.note: Vehicle speed must be below this to enable adaptive idle.

scalars.name: Idle Adaptive Max VSS - Hyst
scalars.note: Hysteresis value for Idle Adaptive Max VSS.

scalars.name: Idle Proportional Enable RPM Delta
scalars.note: Proportional Idle correction will be calculated and updated if RPM Error is higher than this (positive or negative).

scalars.name: Idle Integral Enable RPM Delta
scalars.note: Integral Idle correction will be calculated and updated if RPM Error is higher than this (positive or negative).

scalars.name: Idle Effective Area Max
scalars.note: Maximum desired effective area in square millimeters.

scalars.name: Idle Effective Area Min
scalars.note: Minimum desired effective area in square millimeters.

scalars.name: Idle Effective Area Max - Fail
scalars.note: Maximum desired effective area in square millimeters when MAP, TPS or MAF fault is indicated.

scalars.name: Idle Effective Area Min - Fail
scalars.note: Minimum desired effective area in square millimeters when MAP, TPS or MAF fault is indicated.

scalars.name: Idle Percent Area Max
scalars.note: Maximum percent throttle area from idle.

scalars.name: Idle Percent Area Max - Brake
scalars.note: Maximum percent throttle area from idle when brake is applied.

scalars.name: Fan Med On Airflow
scalars.note: Airflow adder for when medium speed fan transitions to active.

scalars.name: Fan Hi On Airflow
scalars.note: Airflow adder for when high speed fan transitions to active.

scalars.name: Fan Low Off Airflow
scalars.note: Airflow subtractor for when low speed fan transitions to off.

scalars.name: Fan Med Off Airflow
scalars.note: Airflow subtractor for when medium speed fan transitions to off.

scalars.name: Fan Hi Off Airflow
scalars.note: Airflow subtractor for when high speed fan transitions to off.

scalars.name: MAF Steady State Stepdown
scalars.note: Value to step down from minimum startup steady state to minimum steady state.

scalars.name: MAF S/S Stepdown Delay
scalars.note: Time to stay in minimum startup steady state before stepping down to the minimum steady state value.

scalars.name: MAP Estimated Max
scalars.note: Estimated maximum MAP value.

scalars.name: MAP Estimated Min
scalars.note: Estimated minimum MAP value.

scalars.name: MAP Sensor Linear
scalars.note: The linear calibration of the MAP sensor (slope) in pressure per 5 volts.

scalars.name: MAP Sensor Offset
scalars.note: The offset calibration of the MAP sensor. ie. MAP pressure at 0 volts.

scalars.name: Barometric Pressure Sensor Slope
scalars.note: The barometric pressure sensor slope. Typically pressure per volt.

scalars.name: Barometric Pressure Sensor Offset
scalars.note: The barometric pressure sensor offset.

scalars.name: Reversion VE Baro High
scalars.note: The Baro threshold for the Reversion VE High Altitude table.

scalars.name: Reversion VE Baro Low
scalars.note: The Baro threshold for the Reversion VE Low Altitude table.

scalars.name: Dynamic Airflow High RPM Re-Enable
scalars.note: If enabled, RPM must drop below this to re-enable airmass prediction calculations.

scalars.name: RPM Zone Change
scalars.note: Zone change will occur when the RPM value is set to be above or below the zone change thresholds.

scalars.name: RPM Zone Change with AFM
scalars.note: Zone change will occur when the RPM value is set to be above or below the zone change thresholds during AFM mode.

scalars.name: MAP Zone Change
scalars.note: Zone change will occur when the MAP value is set to be above or below the zone change thresholds.

scalars.name: MAP Zone Change with AFM
scalars.note: Zone change will occur when the MAP value is set to be above or below the zone change thresholds during AFM mode.

scalars.name: Dynamic Airflow Prediction Scaler 1
scalars.note: Scales between the current and the 1st upcoming event that is predicted via air per cylinder.

scalars.name: Dynamic Airflow Prediction Scaler 2
scalars.note: Scales between the 1st and the second upcoming event that is predicted via air per cylinder.

scalars.name: MAP Filter Coefficient 1
scalars.note: Coefficient filter for MAP 1.

scalars.name: MAP Filter Coefficient 2
scalars.note: Coefficient filter for MAP 2.

scalars.name: Low Baro Threshold
scalars.note: Variable camshaft Low Barometric pressure threshold.

scalars.name: Med Baro Threshold
scalars.note: Variable camshaft Medium Barometric pressure threshold.

scalars.name: High Baro Threshold
scalars.note: Variable camshaft High Barometric pressure threshold.

scalars.name: Cold Start Enable Delay
scalars.note: Engine must be running longer than this time to enable variable camshaft during cold start.

scalars.name: Cold Start Enable RPM
scalars.note: Above this RPM variable camshaft will enable during cold start.

scalars.name: Cold Start Disable RPM
scalars.note: Below this RPM variable camshaft will disable during cold start.

scalars.name: Intake Cam Position Idle
scalars.note: Intake cam position when at idle and use idle enabled.

scalars.name: Intake Cam Low Oil Temp Enable
scalars.note: Above this oil temperature variable camshaft will enable.

scalars.name: Intake Cam Low Oil Temp Disable
scalars.note: Below this oil temperature variable camshaft will disable.

scalars.name: Intake Cam High Oil Temp Enable
scalars.note: Below this oil temperature variable camshaft will enable.

scalars.name: Intake Cam High Oil Temp Disable
scalars.note: Above this oil temperature variable camshaft will disable.

scalars.name: Exhaust Cam Position Min
scalars.note: Exhaust cam position minimum.

scalars.name: Exhaust Cam Position Idle
scalars.note: Exhaust cam position when at idle and use idle enabled.

scalars.name: Exhaust Cam Low Oil Temp Enable
scalars.note: Above this oil temperature variable camshaft will enable.

scalars.name: Exhaust Cam Low Oil Temp Disable
scalars.note: Below this oil temperature variable camshaft will disable.

scalars.name: Exhaust Cam High Oil Temp Enable
scalars.note: Below this oil temperature variable camshaft will enable.

scalars.name: Exhaust Cam High Oil Temp Disable
scalars.note: Above this oil temperature variable camshaft will disable.

scalars.name: Supercharger Inlet Air Pressure Sensor Offset
scalars.note: The offset calibration of the Supercharger Inlet Pressure sensor. ie. MAP (kPa) at 0V.

scalars.name: Flood Clear Enable TPS
scalars.note: If throttle position is greater than this value then fuel is cut during cranking.

scalars.name: Flood Clear Disable TPS
scalars.note: Fuel is resumed when throttle position is below this value during cranking.

scalars.name: Octane Scalar Delta
scalars.note: The difference between the cylinders will not be allowed to be higher than the set value.

scalars.name: Minimum Rail Pressure
scalars.note: Minimum expected fuel rail pressure used in injector control calculations.

scalars.name: Maximum Rail Pressure
scalars.note: Maximum expected fuel rail pressure used in injector control calculations.

scalars.name: Short Pulse Limit
scalars.note: Injector Pulses shorter than this will be increased by the amount specified in Short Pulse Adder.

scalars.name: Short Pulse Cranking
scalars.note: ECM assumes the engine cranking to be a small pulse if the injector time is lower than the set value.

scalars.name: Injector Off-Time
scalars.note: Duration when injectors are turned off before another injection occurs.

scalars.name: O2 Sensor Upper Limit
scalars.note: Indicates when the O2 sensor is ready for Open Loop if the sensor is below the provided voltage level.

scalars.name: O2 Sensor Lower Limit
scalars.note: Indicates when the O2 sensor is ready for Open Loop if the sensor is above the provided voltage level.

scalars.name: Closed Loop Temperature Threshold
scalars.note: Prevents ECM from switching rapidly between temperatures thresholds from Open Loop to Closed Loop

scalars.name: Minimum Coolant Temp Allowed for Purge
scalars.note: The minimum coolant temperature that is allowed during the closed loop purge.

scalars.name: Enhanced RPM In Closed Loop
scalars.note: If RPM is below set value, ECM will enable enhanced closed loop algorithms.

scalars.name: Simplified RPM in Closed Loop
scalars.note: Above this engine RPM the ECM will use the simplified closed loop algorithms by using O2 Sensor Rich / Lean Threshold, Bank 1 and Bank 2

scalars.name: LTFT Min ECT
scalars.note: LTFT learn is disabled below this engine coolant temperature.

scalars.name: LTFT Max ECT
scalars.note: LTFT learn is disabled above this engine coolant temperature.

scalars.name: LTM Max Limit
scalars.note: The maximum value to which any long term memory cell can increase.

scalars.name: LTM Min Limit
scalars.note: The minimum value to which any long term memory cell can decrease.

scalars.name: LTFT Idle Cells Enable TPS
scalars.note: LTFT idle cells will be used below this throttle position.

scalars.name: LTFT Idle Cells Disable TPS
scalars.note: LTFT idle cells will be disabled above this throttle position.

scalars.name: LTFT Idle Cells Enable VSS
scalars.note: LTFT idle cells will be used below this vehicle speed.

scalars.name: LTFT Idle Cells Disable VSS
scalars.note: LTFT idle cells will be disabled above this vehicle speed.

scalars.name: O2 Sensor Rich/Lean Min
scalars.note: O2 voltage rich/lean threshold minimum limit.

scalars.name: O2 Sensor Rich/Lean Max
scalars.note: O2 voltage rich/lean threshold maximum limit.

scalars.name: O2 Sensor Not Ready Timer
scalars.note: If the O2 voltage is out of range for this period, oxygen sensors are considered not ready.

scalars.name: O2 Sensor Ready Timer
scalars.note: ECM determines if the O2 sensors are ready for the closed loop.

scalars.name: TCS EQ Ratio Min
scalars.note: Minimum EQ Ratio when TCS is active.

scalars.name: ETC Reduced Power EQ Ratio
scalars.note: EQ Ratio when ETC Reduced Power mode is active.

scalars.name: Closed Loop Blend Time
scalars.note: EQ Ratio will be blended from open loop to 1.0 (stoich) over this amount of camshaft reference pulses.

scalars.name: Closed Loop Blend Time 2
scalars.note: EQ Ratio will be blended from open loop to 1.0 (stoich) over this amount of camshaft reference pulses.

scalars.name: Closed Loop Blend Time 3
scalars.note: EQ Ratio will be blended from open loop to 1.0 (stoich) over this amount of camshaft reference pulses.

scalars.name: Power Enrichment Minimum MAP Hysteresis
scalars.note: Hysteresis applied to the minimum MAP, below which power enrichment will disable.

scalars.name: Power Enrichment Minimum RPM
scalars.note: The minimum RPM before power enrichment will enable.

scalars.name: Power Enrichment Minimum RPM Hysteresis
scalars.note: Hysteresis applied to the minimum RPM, below which power enrichment will disable.

scalars.name: Power Enrichment Mode Throttle
scalars.note: After P.E becomes active, throttle has to drop to a certain value before the ECM drops out of P.E mode.

scalars.name: Power Enrich Throttle Bypass Delay
scalars.note: If the movement rate for the delay timer is higher than the P.E mode check, the delay timer is bypassed.

scalars.name: Power Enrich Speed Bypass Delay
scalars.note: If vehicle speed is below a certain value, the delay timer is bypassed.

scalars.name: Power Enrich Upper Bypass Delay
scalars.note: If temperature is set above the current measurement, the delay timer is bypassed.

scalars.name: Power Enrich Lower Bypass Delay
scalars.note: If temperature is set below the current measurement, the delay timer is bypassed.

scalars.name: Power Enrichment Mode Timer
scalars.note: Thresholds must be met for a certain duration before the P.E mode fueling begins. Once this occurs, the delay timer is decremented to 0 when P.E mode fueling begins.

scalars.name: Power Enrichment Ramp In Rate
scalars.note: This is the rate at which fuel is added to reach the desired enrichment value. The smaller this value is, the slower the VCM will reach the desired PE equivalence ratio.

scalars.name: Power Enrichment Ramp Out Rate
scalars.note: This is the rate at which fuel is removed to reach closed loop EQ Ratio. The smaller this value is, the slower the VCM will reach the desired equivalence ratio.

scalars.name: COT Max Enrichment
scalars.note: Maximum allowed enrichment due to COT protection.

scalars.name: Piston Protect Enable RPM
scalars.note: This RPM value must be exceeded to enable Piston Protection (fuel enrich) control.

scalars.name: RPM Limit Extreme Cutoff
scalars.note: Above this RPM, regardless of other settings fuel cutoff will be used.

scalars.name: RPM Limit Extreme Resume
scalars.note: If extreme cutoff active, RPM must drop below this RPM to resume normal limiter operation.

scalars.name: Fuel Cutoff RPM Hysteresis
scalars.note: Fuel will resume when RPM drops below the cutoff RPM by this amount.

scalars.name: RPM Limit Accel Coeff
scalars.note: Coefficient used in engine acceleration filter, lower numbers mean more filtering.

scalars.name: RPM Limit Lamp RPM
scalars.note: Above this RPM the engine overspeed lamp will be lit.

scalars.name: Maximum ECT to Disable DFCO
scalars.note: Below this ECT, DFCO will be disabled.

scalars.name: Minimum RPM to Allow DFCO
scalars.note: Above this engine speed, DFCO will be allowed.

scalars.name: Maximum RPM to Disable DFCO
scalars.note: Below this engine speed, DFCO will be disabled.

scalars.name: Minimum RPM Rate to Disable DFCO
scalars.note: Above this engine speed rate, DFCO will be disabled.

scalars.name: CFCO Enable RPM
scalars.note: RPM must be above this value to enable CFCO.

scalars.name: CFCO Enable ECT
scalars.note: ECT must be above this value to enable CFCO.

scalars.name: DoD Enable ERT
scalars.note: Minimum engine run time before DoD can enable.

scalars.name: DoD Enable VSS P/N
scalars.note: If vehicle speed is below this, DoD will stay enabled when in P/N.

scalars.name: DoD Minimum VSS
scalars.note: If vehicle speed is below this, DoD will disable if active.

scalars.name: DoD Minimum VSS Hyst
scalars.note: If vehicle speed is above Minimum VSS plus this value, DoD can enable if not active.

scalars.name: DoD Enable ECT
scalars.note: Minimum engine coolant temp before DoD can enable.

scalars.name: DoD Enable ECT Hyst
scalars.note: Hysteresis value for Enable ECT.

scalars.name: DoD Disable RPM
scalars.note: DoD is disabled if RPM is above this value.

scalars.name: DoD Disable RPM Hyst
scalars.note: DoD is disabled if RPM is above this value, hysteresis value.

scalars.name: DoD TPS Max
scalars.note: TPS must be below this for DoD to enable.

scalars.name: DoD TPS Max Hyst
scalars.note: Hysteresis value for TPS Max.

scalars.name: DoD TPS Delta Max
scalars.note: TPS change (12.5ms) must be below this for DoD to enable (12.5ms).

scalars.name: Transient Fuel MAP Filter
scalars.note: Filter coefficient for the filtered MAP calculation.

scalars.name: Transient Fuel Enable Delay
scalars.note: Transient fuel will not enable until this many crank reference pulses are detected.

scalars.name: Transient Fuel Delta MAP
scalars.note: Filtered MAP change required for transient fuel calculations.

scalars.name: Transient Fuel Delta TPS
scalars.note: TPS change required for transient fuel calculations.

scalars.name: Fuel Delta Min Increase
scalars.note: Minimum commanded fuel delta to add correction (only compensate for reasonably sized transients).

scalars.name: Transient Fuel Max
scalars.note: Maximum Transient fuel mass allowed.

scalars.name: Maximum Ethanol Percentage
scalars.note: Maximum reported ethanol percentage.

scalars.name: Composition Change Threshold
scalars.note: Minimum composition change to update flex fuel composition.

scalars.name: Composition Change Delay Volume
scalars.note: Volume of fuel required to be used by the engine before new composition reaches the engine.

scalars.name: Composition Change Transition Volume
scalars.note: Volume of fuel used by the engine during a fuel composition transition, after the delay volume is used.

scalars.name: Spark Smoothing Max Torque Delta
scalars.note: Maximum allowed torque correction, positive and negative, made by spark smoothing alogorithm.

scalars.name: Spark Smoothing Max Torque Bias
scalars.note: Maximum allowed torque bias used by spark smoothing alogorithm.

scalars.name: Spark Smoothing Max Torque Loss
scalars.note: Maximum allowed torque reduction caused by spark smoothing alogorithm.

scalars.name: Bidir Retard Max
scalars.note: Maximum allowed retard when using bidirectional scanner VCM controls.

scalars.name: Knock Retard Disable Time
scalars.note: Knock retard will be disabled for this many crank refernce pulses when burst knock is active.

scalars.name: Knock Retard Max Step
scalars.note: Maximum change in knock retard per crank reference pulse.

scalars.name: Knock Retard Maximum RPM
scalars.note: Knock retard is disabled above this RPM.

scalars.name: Knock Retard Minimum RPM
scalars.note: Knock retard is enabled below this RPM.

scalars.name: Knock Retard Fault Mult
scalars.note: Knock retard multiplier when a fault is detected (P0325, P0326, P0327, P0332).

scalars.name: Knock Retard Valid Max
scalars.note: Maximum allowed knock retard before the ECM considers it false knock.

scalars.name: Knock Learn Min MAP
scalars.note: MAP must be above this to enable knock learn.

scalars.name: Knock Learn Min IAT
scalars.note: Inlet air temperature must be above this to enable knock learn.

scalars.name: Knock Learn Min RPM
scalars.note: RPM must be above this to enable knock learn.

scalars.name: Knock Learn Min Coolant Temp
scalars.note: Engine coolant temperature must be above this to enable knock learn.

scalars.name: Knock Learn Up Thresh
scalars.note: Knock Learn factor is incremented (moved towards low octane) if knock retard exceeds this value.

scalars.name: Knock Learn Fault
scalars.note: Knock Learn factor when a fault is detected (P0325, P0326, P0327, P0332).

scalars.name: Burst Knock Hold Time
scalars.note: Time in crank reference pulses that burst knock retard will hold before decay begins.

scalars.name: Burst Knock Decay Time
scalars.note: Time in crank reference pulses that burst knock retard will be decayed after the hold time.

scalars.name: Burst Knock Learn Thresh
scalars.note: Burst knock will learn down if no knock detected during burst enable.

scalars.name: Burst Knock Learn Down
scalars.note: Burst knock learn down step size.

scalars.name: Burst Knock Learn Up
scalars.note: Burst knock learn up step size.

scalars.name: Burst Knock Learn Min
scalars.note: Burst knock learn minimum value.

scalars.name: Burst Knock Learn Fault
scalars.note: Burst knock learn values when a fault is detected (P0325, P0326, P0327, P0332).

scalars.name: Static Retard Enable Cylair
scalars.note: Cylinder airmass must be above this to enable static retard.

scalars.name: Knock Sensor Transient Mode Airmass
scalars.note: Minimum airmass required for knock sensor transient operation.

scalars.name: Knock Sensor Transient Mode RPM Decrease
scalars.note: Minimum RPM decrease required for knock sensor transient operation.

scalars.name: Knock Sensor Transient Mode RPM Increase
scalars.note: Minimum RPM increase required for knock sensor transient operation.

scalars.name: Knock Sensor Transient Mode TPS Decrease
scalars.note: Minimum TPS decrease required for knock sensor transient operation.

scalars.name: Knock Sensor Transient Mode TPS Increase
scalars.note: Minimum TPS increase required for knock sensor transient operation.

scalars.name: Trans Input Torque Limit
scalars.note: Maximum allowed transmission input torque.

scalars.name: Trans Output Torque Limit
scalars.note: Maximum allowed transmission output torque.

scalars.name: Front Axle Torque Limit
scalars.note: Maximum Front Axle Torque (4WD applications).

scalars.name: Front Propshaft Torque Limit
scalars.note: Maximum Front Propshaft Torque (4WD applications).

scalars.name: Rear Axle Torque Limit
scalars.note: Maximum Rear Axle Torque.

scalars.name: Rear Propshaft Torque Limit
scalars.note: Maximum Rear Propshaft Torque.

scalars.name: Fast Torque Exit Disable
scalars.note: If Fast Torque Exit is active the difference between driver demanded torque and engine torque must be less than this to disable.

scalars.name: Fast Torque Exit ETC Limit
scalars.note: If Fast Torque Exit is active the ETC limit will be set to this amount below the driver demanded torque.

scalars.name: TCS Enable ECT
scalars.note: Above this coolant temp torque reduction for TCS will be allowed.

scalars.name: Delivered Torque Max
scalars.note: Maximum engine torque range for delivered torque signal to TCS system. ie. at this torque Duty Cycle Max will be commanded.

scalars.name: Delivered Torque Min
scalars.note: Minimum engine torque range for delivered torque signal to TCS system. ie. at this torque Duty Cycle Min will be commanded.

scalars.name: Delivered Torque Duty Cycle Max
scalars.note: Maximum allowed duty cycle for delivered torque signal to TCS system.

scalars.name: Delivered Torque Duty Cycle Min
scalars.note: Minimum allowed duty cycle for delivered torque signal to TCS system.

scalars.name: TCS Duty Cycle Hi
scalars.note: Below this input duty cycle traction control is active.

scalars.name: TCS Duty Cycle Low
scalars.note: Above this input duty cycle traction control is active.

scalars.name: TCS Fail Duty Cycle Hi
scalars.note: Below this input duty cycle traction control is failed.

scalars.name: TCS Fail Duty Cycle Low
scalars.note: Above this input duty cycle traction control is failed.

scalars.name: Traction Control RPM Enable
scalars.note: If the TCS is disabled due to RPM falling below Traction Control Disable, then it must be greater than the set value before TCS can be active.

scalars.name: Traction Control RPM Disable
scalars.note: If engine RPM falls below the set value, then the TCS will be disabled

scalars.name: Traction Control Runtime Enable
scalars.note: Engine runtime must be on for a certain time before the traction control system seeks torque reduction

scalars.name: Torque Loss Runtime
scalars.note: Engine runtime before spark is reduced by Traction Control System.

scalars.name: Oil Pressure Low Hyst
scalars.note: Oil pressure low warning hysteresis value.

scalars.name: Oil Pressure Low Delay
scalars.note: Oil pressure must be low for this time to enable lamp.

scalars.name: Oil Press Warning Delay
scalars.note: The delay for the oil pressure warning to occur after oil pressure has been determined to be low.

scalars.name: Oil Temperature High
scalars.note: Oil temperature high warning level.

scalars.name: Oil Temperature High Hyst
scalars.note: Oil temperature high warning hysteresis value.

scalars.name: MAF Freq Test ERT Min
scalars.note: Minimum engine run time before MAF frequency tests can be enabled.

scalars.name: MAF Freq Test IGNV Min
scalars.note: Minimum ignition voltage before MAF frequency tests can be enabled.

scalars.name: MAF Freq Test RPM Min
scalars.note: Minimum RPM before MAF frequency tests can be enabled.

scalars.name: MAF Freq Test Enable Delay
scalars.note: Enable delay before MAF tests will run once enabled.

scalars.name: MAF Freq Test High Count Thresh
scalars.note: Number of high frequency counts above the fail frequency before MAF DTC P0103 will be set.

scalars.name: MAF Freq Test Low Count Thresh
scalars.note: Number of low frequency counts below the fail frequency before MAF DTC P0102 will be set.

scalars.name: P0101, P0106, P0121 Perf Test - Min ECT
scalars.note: Below this engine coolant temperature, P0101, P0106 and P0121 tests will not run.

scalars.name: P0101, P0106, P0121 Perf Test - Max ECT
scalars.note: Above this engine coolant temperature, P0101, P0106 and P0121 tests will not run.

scalars.name: MAP Error Check 1
scalars.note: Determines if the first MAP value is wrong if error value is larger than set value.

scalars.name: MAP Error Check 2
scalars.note: Determines if the second MAP value is wrong if error value is larger than set value.

scalars.name: Upstream Catalyst Rich Thresh
scalars.note: Above this threshold O2 sensor values will be considered rich for pre catalyst.

scalars.name: Downstream Lean Thresh
scalars.note: Below this threshold O2 sensor values will be considered lean for post catalyst.

scalars.name: Downstream Rich Thresh
scalars.note: Above this threshold O2 sensor values will be considered rich for post catalyst.

scalars.name: Shift Torque Factor 2-3
scalars.note: Multiplies the shift torque by this factor.

scalars.name: Shift Torque Factor 3-4
scalars.note: Multiplies the shift torque by this factor.

scalars.name: Shift Torque Factor 4-5
scalars.note: Multiplies the shift torque by this factor.

scalars.name: Shift Torque Factor 5-6
scalars.note: Multiplies the shift torque by this factor.

scalars.name: Shift Torque Factor 1-3
scalars.note: Multiplies the shift torque by this factor.

scalars.name: Shift Torque Factor 1-4
scalars.note: Multiplies the shift torque by this factor.

scalars.name: Shift Torque Factor 2-4
scalars.note: Multiplies the shift torque by this factor.

scalars.name: Shift Torque Factor 2-6
scalars.note: Multiplies the shift torque by this factor.

scalars.name: Shift Torque Factor 3-5
scalars.note: Multiplies the shift torque by this factor.

scalars.name: Shift Torque Factor 4-6
scalars.note: Multiplies the shift torque by this factor.

scalars.name: Shift Torque Factor 1-2 Adder
scalars.note: Adds to the Shift Torque Factor.

scalars.name: Shift Torque Factor 2-3 Adder
scalars.note: Adds to the Shift Torque Factor.

scalars.name: Shift Torque Factor 3-4 Adder
scalars.note: Adds to the Shift Torque Factor.
